websites.title: Websites
websites.description: One per line, up to 1,000. A domain (allbirds.com) or a full address (https://www.allbirds.com). The homepage is checked unless you give a longer address. One request per website.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most websites answer without a proxy. Sites behind a bot challenge are reported as blocked (not charged); a residential proxy can get past some of them.
